findings.title: Clarity is certified before it is stated
findings.claim: The certification particle presents the following clarity as established rather than tentative before the perfect verb arrives.
findings.mechanism: The particle precedes the perfect clarity verb and fixes the evidential clause's temporal and assertive force.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader receives the certainty of the evidence clause before learning how the clarity is described.
findings.containment: The particle certifies the narrated clarity; it does not by itself adjudicate every later interpretation of insight.

epistemic.reason: QAC and trusted word-analysis evidence identify the particle's local function.

findings.title: The evidence has already become clear
findings.claim: The perfect Form V clarity verb presents the evidence as already realized and broadly recoverable from the dwellings.
findings.mechanism: The perfect form marks completed becoming-clear, and the source phrase supplies the dwellings from which that clarity is available.
findings.reader_payoff: Clarity emerges from the visible remains as an accomplished fact rather than a lesson still waiting for an explaining agent.
findings.containment: The claim is about the local evidential event; it does not make the dwellings an independent speaking subject.

epistemic.reason: Trusted morphology and attachment evidence establish the completed clarity event.

findings.title: Audience clarity frames failed insight
findings.claim: The ayah places clarity available to the audience beside the closing insight state of the peoples who are nevertheless diverted.
findings.mechanism: The opening evidence clause addresses the hearers, while the final participle returns to the peoples inside the obstruction sequence.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees a perception frame in which evidence is available and insight is named, yet movement is still captured by diversion.
findings.containment: This is a local relation among the supplied words; it does not turn the audience into a morally identical group or rank kinds of seeing.

epistemic.reason: Trusted opening and closing support establish the local perception frame.

findings.title: Clarity emerges from the evidence itself
findings.claim: The Form V makes the clarity appear self-manifesting from the evidential surface of the dwellings.
findings.mechanism: The becoming-clear form is attached to the source phrase from the dwellings without a named explaining agent in that clause.
findings.reader_payoff: The ruins function as self-disclosing evidence within the sentence, while the later adversarial action is separately named and active.
findings.containment: Self-manifesting describes the local clarity construction; it does not deny all causal agency beyond this clause.

epistemic.reason: The trusted Form V and source-phrase evidence support this bounded contrast.

findings.title: The audience receives the disclosure
findings.claim: The dative phrase routes the manifest evidence to the addressed audience as recipients and accountable witnesses.
findings.mechanism: The lām suffix is governed by the clarity construction and marks the second-person plural hearers as the endpoint of disclosure.
findings.reader_payoff: The ruins are not only somewhere in history; the grammar places the listener before what they reveal.
findings.containment: The phrase marks grammatical reception and witness-position; it does not make the audience the source of the clarity.

epistemic.reason: Trusted attachment evidence supports the dative recipient and address shift.

findings.title: The source attachment stays primary with a live pressure
findings.claim: The source preposition primarily makes the dwellings the origin or medium of clarity, while the phrase can also press toward identifying the named peoples through their remains.
findings.mechanism: Trusted attachment evidence favors the source relation; the alternative modifying pressure remains bounded inside the same local phrase.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can hold both proof-from-the-dwellings and identification-through-the-remains without losing the base syntax.
findings.containment: The alternative does not control the parse and does not replace the primary source relation.

epistemic.reason: The candidate support explicitly narrows the ambiguity under the stronger source attachment.

findings.title: Place becomes the medium of clarity
findings.claim: The source preposition makes the dwellings the origin, medium, or sufficient sample from which clarity comes.
findings.mechanism: The preposition connects the governed dwelling noun to the clarity verb as its evidential source rather than as a merely adjacent location.
findings.reader_payoff: A place becomes an active evidentiary surface: the reader sees why the dwellings can disclose the fate of their inhabitants.
findings.containment: The source relation does not turn the place into an independent agent or suppress the ordinary meaning of dwellings.

epistemic.reason: Trusted attachment evidence directly supports the source-medium relation.

findings.title: Clear evidence meets available inward discernment
findings.claim: The dwellings disclose external evidence while the closing word supplies inward discernment, so the local failure is legible as diversion occurring with evidence and perceptual capacity present.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers for disclosure, settled dwellings, and heart-sight contact one another around the diversion clause; the reconstructed HFT nomination changes the reading from simple failure to see into a gap between seeing and governing movement.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can perceive why the ayah places clear ruins and insight beside one another: available evidence does not automatically become governing commitment.
findings.containment: This qualified local synthesis does not assert complete knowledge, conscious defiance as a settled doctrine, or bodily eyesight; the HFT source is reconstructed and legacy_unbound.

epistemic.reason: The branches are focus-anchored and lexically accepted, but the activating synthesis comes from a reconstructed HFT record with legacy_unbound reader identity.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam şeyin görünür, anlaşılır ve açık hale gelmesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: تَّبَيَّنَ carries becoming visible, understandable, and clear.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: مَسَٰكِنِهِمْ supplies the settled dwellings whose remains make the evidence concrete.
branch_activations.activation: The clarity carrier meets the dwelling phrase, so the dwellings are heard as the surface through which disclosure becomes legible.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: External evidence becomes clear from the settled sites while the peoples are diverted.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not make the dwellings a speaking agent or claim that every form of clarity is self-produced.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Kişi bir yere yerleşir ve orada yaşamını sürdürür.
branch_activations.carrier: مَسَٰكِنِهِمْ carries the concrete places in which the peoples settled and lived.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: تَّبَيَّنَ supplies the disclosure that turns those settled places into readable evidence.
branch_activations.activation: The settled-place carrier meets the becoming-clear trigger, so habitation is perceived as the material medium of disclosure.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The places once inhabited remain available as evidence of the peoples' fate.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not replace the ordinary dwelling reference with an abstract settlement metaphor.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şeyi bilme, kalpte nüfuz eden kavrayış ve doğrulanmış anlayış çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: مُسْتَبْصِرِينَ carries inward knowing, discernment, and verified understanding.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The focus pairing of clear disclosure and dwellings supplies external evidence alongside the closing perceptual state.
branch_activations.activation: The inward-discernment carrier meets the already-disclosed evidence, making the cognition-and-conduct gap visible in the same local sentence.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Diversion occurs while evidence is clear and inward discernment is available; seeing does not automatically govern movement.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim complete knowledge, conscious rejection as a settled doctrine, or the bodily-sight branch.

findings.title: Beautification captures valuation while the path remains
findings.claim: The local mechanism can be read as attractive revaluation of the peoples' own purposive deeds, through which the known adversary reroutes their action away from a traversable way.
findings.mechanism: The five focus carriers connect beautification, the rebellious agent, intentional deeds, transitive turning-away, and an extended path; the reconstructed HFT change is from simple external blocking to valuation-mediated diversion.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees how people may continue acting while their agency is redirected through an appearance made attractive to them.
findings.containment: This does not say every deed is evil, deny the named adversarial agency, or claim that the path disappears; the synthesis remains a qualified reconstructed nomination.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus branches land, but their multi-branch synthesis comes from a reconstructed HFT record with legacy_unbound provenance.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir şey güzelleştirilir veya onda bulunan güzellik eylem ya da söz yoluyla görünür hale getirilir.
branch_activations.carrier: زَيَّنَ carries making something beautiful or making its beauty visible.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: أَعْمَالَهُمْ supplies the deeds whose valuation is being altered.
branch_activations.activation: The beautification carrier meets the owned deeds as its object, so appearance is attached to purposive practice rather than to a neutral ornament.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Their own deeds become attractive in valuation before the following diversion.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that the deeds become intrinsically good or that beautification always has this harmful result.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Ad, türü ne olursa olsun azgın, taşkın ve başkaldıran varlığı belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: ٱلشَّيْطَٰنُ carries the named rebellious and overstepping adversarial being.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: زَيَّنَ supplies the concrete beautifying operation attributed to that agent.
branch_activations.activation: The named adversarial carrier meets the beautification act, so the agent is perceived through the way valuation is engineered.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The named adversary operates by making the deeds attractive before the diversion.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not expand the branch into every possible shaytan derivation or erase the grammatical proper-name reading.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Bir yapanın bilerek ortaya koyduğu iş veya eylem anlamı çekirdektir.
branch_activations.carrier: أَعْمَالَهُمْ carries the peoples' purposive work and action.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: زَيَّنَ places those actions inside an active valuation operation.
branch_activations.activation: The broad action carrier meets beautification, so their own agency remains active while its evaluation is altered.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The capture works through their continuing practice, not through a noun that already means evil.
branch_activations.boundary: The action branch remains broad and does not settle the moral quality of every individual deed.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Özne, yöneldiği şeyden yüz çevirir, uzaklaşır veya ona katılmaktan kaçınır.
branch_activations.carrier: صَدَّهُمْ carries turning away and causing separation from a directed object.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: ٱلسَّبِيلِ supplies the route from which the people are turned.
branch_activations.activation: The turning-away carrier meets the path target, so the result is a rerouting of movement and orientation.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The peoples are redirected away from an existing route.
branch_activations.boundary: This core facet records the direction change; it does not claim destruction of the path or select every transitive nuance.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Geçişli kullanımda özne, başka bir kişiyi belirli bir işten men eder ve yönünü o işten çevirir.
branch_activations.carrier: صَدَّهُمْ carries the transitive act of turning the people away.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: The attached plural object and the governed path identify both whom the act affects and what it blocks access to.
branch_activations.activation: The transitive facet meets the explicit object and path relation, making the diversion an effected obstruction of other people.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: Their access is actively redirected away from the recognized way.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not add a separate agent beyond the sentence or imply that the people lose all capacity to act.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: yol ve bir amaca ulaştıran yol
branch_activations.facet_statement: İnsanların üzerinde yürüyüp ilerlediği uzanmış yol veya yolları belirtir.
branch_activations.carrier: ٱلسَّبِيلِ carries an extended traversable road or way.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: صَدَّهُمْ supplies the obstruction that acts against access to that route.
branch_activations.activation: The route carrier meets the turning-away action, so the path becomes a course from which movement is rerouted.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The way remains a traversable course even as the people are turned from it.
branch_activations.boundary: The branch does not make the noun a free pouring image or claim a surah-wide path system.

findings.title: Settlement survives as testimony against permanence
findings.claim: The places that once settled and stabilized the peoples survive in the local reading as evidence of their disappearance rather than as proof of durable stability.
findings.mechanism: The settled-place and motion-ceasing facets of the dwelling word meet the becoming-manifest facet of clarity; the reconstructed HFT change reverses settlement's stabilizing function into testimony.
findings.reader_payoff: The ruins become the visible remainder of a failed claim to permanence: what was meant to hold life in place now exposes its absence.
findings.containment: This is a qualified local reversal, not a claim that the dwelling word always means permanence, nor a denial that the ordinary referent is their homes.

epistemic.reason: The exact focus branches land, but the settlement-reversal synthesis comes from a reconstructed HFT record with legacy_unbound provenance.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Önceden hareket eden veya çalkalanan şeyin hareketi sona erer.
branch_activations.carrier: مَسَٰكِنِهِمْ carries the settled place whose motion and life have come to rest in the ruin scene.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: تَّبَيَّنَ makes the settled remains manifest as evidence.
branch_activations.activation: The motion-ceasing carrier meets the disclosure trigger, so the stillness of the site becomes readable rather than merely empty.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The settled places outlast their occupants as visible testimony.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not reduce the dwellings to silence alone or claim that physical motion is the only meaning of the scene.

branch_activations.branch_gloss: sabit yer ve konum bildiren özel kullanımlar
branch_activations.facet_statement: Çoğul kalıp ifadeler kişilerin yerlerini, konumlarını, düzeylerini, evlerini veya alışılmış düzenlerini gösterebilir.
branch_activations.carrier: مَسَٰكِنِهِمْ carries the plural homes and settled locations of the people.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: تَّبَيَّنَ supplies the disclosure that turns those locations into a surviving witness.
branch_activations.activation: The fixed-location facet meets the becoming-manifest trigger, so the places once associated with stability expose the absence of their occupants.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The instruments of settlement survive as testimony against durable human permanence.
branch_activations.boundary: This specialized location pressure remains attached to the supplied plural-home expression and does not replace its ordinary dwelling sense.

branch_activations.facet_statement: Çekirdek anlam şeyin görünür, anlaşılır ve açık hale gelmesidir.
branch_activations.carrier: تَّبَيَّنَ carries becoming manifest and clear.
branch_activations.independent_trigger: مَسَٰكِنِهِمْ supplies the former sites of settlement that remain to be read.
branch_activations.activation: The manifestation carrier meets the settled-place carrier, converting the former stability of the site into legible testimony.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The dwellings disclose the failure of permanence through what remains of them.
branch_activations.boundary: This does not claim that the word's clarity branch is detached from the source phrase or that all ruins carry the same inference.
